title: Hearty Canadian Beef Hash
description: A funky, velvety Canadian dish featuring onion salt and a rich beef broth, perfect for a cold winter's day. Serve hot in a stone bowl.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large stone-bowl dolsot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and mushrooms to the pot and continue to simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Season the hash with onion salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
